en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from Abī Sa’īd Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Zakariyyā Al-‘Adwi Al-Basri, from ‘Amr ibn Mukhtār, from Isḥāq ibn Bishr, from Qawwām servant of Quraysh, from his master ‘Umar ibn Hubayrah, who said:

I saw the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) while Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.) were sitting on his lap. He kept kissing Ḥasan (a.s.) and then kissing Ḥusain (a.s.) and saying to him, “Woe unto those who (will) kill you.”
